title: Mechanism
description: Schema for Mechanism Ascriptions — the logical causal unit. Defines the owning Structure, function label, and the Starlark rule. DM auto-derives Effectors and Receptors from the rule's AST. DM input = DM output (1:1). Tenant-defined archetypes extending Mechanism MUST reference this schema via a top-level $ref.

structure.description: ID reference to the owning Structure.

function.description: Capability label describing what the Mechanism does (e.g., 'UserValidation', 'PaymentRouting', 'OrderTransformation'). MUST be unique within the owning Structure's scope — two Mechanisms in the same Structure cannot share the same function.

rule.description: Starlark source code defining the Mechanism's behavioral logic. The definition-manager auto-derives Effectors and Receptors from the rule AST. The sandbox exposes only the `sys` namespace, host functions (`now`, `uuid7`, `fullmatch`, `search`), and Starlark built-ins; `load()` is forbidden and execution is bounded. The first executable statement MUST be exactly one `sys.receive("<exact-archetype-$id>")` call. Outputs use `sys.effect("<exact-archetype-$id>", data)` with optional `.by("<exact-effector-$id>")`, `.receive("<exact-feedback-$id>")`, and `.on("<exact-receptor-$id>")` qualifiers in the order `effect` → [`by`] → [`receive` → [`on`]]. Every Archetype argument MUST be a string-literal Archetype URI that resolves in the governed scope. A feedback `.receive()` creates a closed loop and auto-derives a Receptor; otherwise the effect is fire-and-forget.
